ModMetaData.name: Smokeleaf Nerfed
ModMetaData.author: TheGoofyOne
ModMetaData.description:
Smokeleaf Nerfed = New 420 Reality
This is my 1.2 re-write to XPATH patching, without the graphics, to my 420 Reality MOD.
Tired of the leaf bringing you down on the RIM? No more!! Changes vanilla smokeleaf to be less harmful on the RIM by changing the following:
When smoking smokeleaf: Reduced Rest need from .1 to .15 Reduced the tolerance from .03 to .003 Raised the minimum tolerance to addict from .15 to .75 Reduced the existing addiction severity offset from .06 to .006
The Smokeleaf High Itself: Increased the amount of severity decreased per day from -1.0 to -1.8 Increased consciousness from -0.3 to +0.15 Increased moving from -0.1 to +0.15 Added hearing boost of +0.15 Added metabolism boost of +0.15
MOD Incompatibilities: None uses xpath patching Safe to add and remove.
